verdict.rationale: The Gemini CLI README states 'No API key management - just sign in with your Google account', and it positions paid tier access as a separate option, which implies the default sign-in path is free. A community user independently confirms a 'generous daily free quota'. Another user reports that Workspace accounts fail to log in, but that concerns work accounts, not the personal accounts this story names. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the specific free-tier quota and limits, and explicit official wording tying personal-account sign-in to the free tier.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys
